lines: I remember sinking far below myself. You hauled the line in.
The dark had me hooked. You cut the line clean.
You helped pull me back when even my name felt far away.
Your face breaks the surface of that memory, then slips under again.
I remember a taste like bad river water, then breathing like it was new.
The memory is rough around the edges, but your face stayed in it.
I remember you through deep water and panic. Do not crowd the bank.
I know you helped. I also remember why my hands still shake.
The cure left echoes behind. Stand where I can breathe around them.
